result.summary: 本文旨在寻找最简单的测试时扩展方法并实现强推理性能 [S1.p1]。作者构建了仅含 1,000 个问题的数据集 s1K，并提出 budget forcing 来控制测试时计算量 [S1.p2]。在 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 上微调后，s1-32B 在竞赛数学问题上超过 o1-preview 最高 27%，并可将 AIME24 性能从 50% 外推至 57% [abstract]。作者开源了模型、数据和代码 [S1.p4]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：在众多 o1 复现尝试均未公开复现出清晰的测试时扩展行为的情况下，实现测试时扩展和强推理性能的最简单方法是什么 [S1.p1]。其动机在于，OpenAI o1 验证了测试时扩展范式的可行性，但未公开方法，而 DeepSeek R1 等复现依赖大规模强化学习和数百万样本 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: Thus, we ask: what is the simplest approach to achieve both test-time scaling and strong reasoning performance?
the viability of this paradigm was recently validated by OpenAI o1
DeepSeek R1 has successfully replicated o1-level performance, also employing reinforcement learning via millions of samples and multiple training stages
none have openly replicated a clear test-time scaling behavior

method.text: 方法包含两部分：一是构建 s1K 数据集，从 59K 问题池中依据质量、难度、多样性三个准则筛选出 1,000 个问题，并配以从 Gemini Thinking Experimental 蒸馏的推理轨迹 [S1.p2][S2.SS2.p1]。二是提出 budget forcing，通过在模型试图结束思考时强制插入结束思考标记或追加“Wait”来缩短或延长思考过程 [S1.p2][S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。作者在 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 上进行监督微调得到 s1-32B [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: we construct s1K, which consists of 1,000 carefully curated questions paired with reasoning traces and answers distilled from Gemini Thinking Experimental
we go through three stages of filtering to arrive at a minimal set of 1,000 samples relying on our three guiding data principles: Quality, Difficulty, and Diversity
we forcefully end the thinking process by appending an end-of-thinking token delimiter
we suppress the generation of the end-of-thinking token delimiter and instead append “Wait” to the model’s current reasoning trace
We perform supervised fine-tuning (SFT) of an off-the-shelf pretrained model on our small dataset

experiments.text: 训练方面，作者在 16 块 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上对 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 进行监督微调，耗时 26 分钟 [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。评估使用三个基准：AIME24（30 题）、MATH500（500 题）和 GPQA Diamond（198 题），默认温度 0 并测量准确率 [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。作者还将 s1-32B 与 OpenAI o1 系列、DeepSeek r1 系列、QwQ-32B-preview、Sky-T1-32B-Preview、Bespoke-32B 和 Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking Experimental 等模型进行了对比 [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

evidence.quote: Finetuning took 26 minutes on 16 NVIDIA H100 GPUs with PyTorch FSDP
AIME24 has 30 problems that were used in the 2024 American Invitational Mathematics Examination (AIME)
MATH500 is a benchmark of competition math problems of varying difficulty
GPQA Diamond consists of 198 PhD-level science questions from Biology, Chemistry and Physics
we evaluate with a temperature of 0 (greedy) and measure accuracy (equivalent to pass@1)
We benchmark s1-32B against: OpenAI o1 series, closed-source models that popularized test-time scaling; DeepSeek r1 series

findings.text: s1-32B 在竞赛数学问题上超过 o1-preview 最高 27%（MATH 和 AIME24）[abstract]。使用 budget forcing 可将 AIME24 性能从 50% 外推至 57% [abstract]。在数据消融中，随机选择、仅选最长推理轨迹或仅选最大多样性均导致显著更差性能（AIME24 平均约 -30%），而训练全部 59K 样本相比 1K 选择没有带来实质提升 [S1.p3]。在测试时扩展方法比较中，budget forcing 具有完美可控性、良好扩展斜率和最佳 AIME24 分数 [S5.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

evidence.quote: our model s1-32B exceeds o1-preview on competition math questions by up to 27% (MATH and AIME24)
from 50% to 57% on AIME24
Random selection, selecting samples with the longest reasoning traces, or only selecting maximally diverse samples all lead to significantly worse performance (around $-$ 30% on AIME24 on average)
Training on our full data pool of 59K examples, a superset of s1K, does not offer substantial gains over our 1K selection
we find that budget forcing provides perfect control, good scaling, and leads to our best AIME24 score

limitations.text: 作者指出 budget forcing 在进一步扩展时有两个关键限制：性能最终会趋于平缓，且受底层语言模型的上下文窗口约束 [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。此外，抑制结束思考标记过于频繁可能导致模型陷入重复循环而非继续推理 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。作者还提到，能否仅用 1,000 个样本达到 r1-32B 的性能仍是一个开放问题 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

evidence.quote: it has two key limitations when scaling further: it eventually flattens out ( Figure 4), and the context window of the underlying language model constrains it
Suppressing the end-of-thinking token delimiter too often can lead the model into repetitive loops instead of continued reasoning
It is an open question whether one can achieve their performance with just 1,000 samples
